options.customCss: :root { --color-primary: #2b6cb0; --color-primary-hover: #2c5282; } body { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef6fc 0%, #ddeaf6 100%); } .n8n-form { max-width: 640px; margin: 40px auto; padding: 36px 40px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(43, 108, 176, 0.15); border-top: 6px solid #2b6cb0; } h1 { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; color: #1e3a5f; margin-bottom: 8px; } label { font-weight: 600; color: #4a5568; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; } input, select, textarea { border: 1.5px solid #c3d8ec; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 15px; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: #2b6cb0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(43,108,176,0.18); outline: none; } button[type=submit] { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2b6cb0 0%, #2c5282 100%); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .2s; } button[type=submit]:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(43,108,176,0.35); }
